title: phaius mishmensis
intro: Phaius mishmensis, commonly known as the Blue-veined Phaius, is a type of orchid plant native to the Himalayan region. It is a terrestrial orchid with striking blue-green leaves and purple flowers that bloom in the summer months. The plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and skin disorders, due to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The Blue-veined Phaius contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
